text:
haley: Hey — CI linkcheck failed on the localized build, throwing anchor errors for /docs/zh/getting-started. Full error below.

haley: ```
LinkCheckerError: Broken anchor '#intro' found in /docs/zh/getting-started.html
  Referenced from /docs/getting-started.html -> /docs/zh/getting-started.html#intro
  1 file(s) failed
``` 

maria: ugh, this is the one that came up after the i18n path rearrange last week. The heading id in the Chinese page was changed to `#简介` by the translator tool. 

ryan: is this a bug in the anchor normalizer or a content mismatch? Does the English file still use `#intro`?

haley: English has `## Intro` which slugifies to `intro`. The zh page has `## 简介` which slugifies differently. Link from the English page uses a hardcoded `#intro` fragment — we should change cross-lang links to use the canonical id or avoid fragments.

akash: quick idea: make the cross-language pointer use the page-level redirect without fragment, e.g. `/docs/zh/getting-started` and then add a small inline anchor in zh page with an explicit HTML id `<!-- anchor: intro -->` so the fragment will exist.

leo: adding explicit HTML ids in translated pages is fine but needs translator signoff. Also we should update the linkcheck rule to ignore fragment mismatches for i18n links for now.

maria: I'll open a small PR to add `<!-- anchor: intro -->` at the top of the zh file and update the english link to remove the fragment. Also will add a short note in the localization guide.

ryan: thanks. Can you also add a unit for linkcheck that logs missing fragments as warnings not failures for `/docs/*/` i18n paths? That will reduce CI noise.

docs-bot: Deploy preview built: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai/ — linkcheck step still failing.

haley: OK PR #4587 created: drop fragment from en link + inject explicit anchor in zh. I'll mark it as `docs:linkfix` and assign to @maria for review. 

maria: reviewing now, will merge once tests are green. :thumbsup:

ryan: follow-up task — track in docs backlog to add a lint rule that flags cross-lang fragment references. Filed as DOCS-112.

haley: thanks all — reopening if CI complains after merge. :pray:
